outcome: Obstetric complications (premature labor, PROM, GDM, preeclampsia)
cohort: 74 pregnant women with AVB who delivered at a tertiary care center over a 10-year period
finding: Most women with AVB had successful pregnancies and deliveries, but those with II° AVB type II and III° AVB require vigilant monitoring during pregnancy and postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed more frequently in patients with high-degree AVB compared to those with low-degree AVB.
